question: A square tile of area 225 cm² is cut into two equal rectangular tiles. What will be the perimeter of each new tile?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Side of the square = √225 = 15 cm.

When cut into two equal halves, the sides of each new rectangle are 15 cm and 7.5 cm.

Perimeter = 2 × (15 + 7.5) = 2 × 22.5 = 45 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 45 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Area of the square tile = 225 cm²

The square is cut into two equal rectangular tiles.

**Formula Used:**

Area of Square = (Side)²

Perimeter of Rectangle = 2 × (Length + Breadth)
